description: Test-account fixture for the classification footnote in docs/Senseml reference/concepts/file-types.md (PR #741). Same layout as the other fixture folders: paths are relative to this file, except `pdf`, which is relative to the repo root and, despite its name, can be a spreadsheet. Sensible classifies by the doc type's description, so it describes the test spreadsheets in scripts/test/assets/. The config has no fields: classification doesn't use it, but every fixture needs one, plus a reference document, so you can open it in the SenseML editor.
